## Analyzed by Rachael Dee and Bella Hocker

  Bella and I analyzed survey data from COMP110 students. We found that the majority students would it beneficial to have pre-lecture videos for COMP110.  We recommend that the COMP110 instructors create pre-lecture videos that are 5-10 minutes long and include examples to help students better understand the course material.
